$comment: Expected values from Tarık's brief (9 Nov 2026), checked by hand. F* fixtures come from the Solved Circuits channel; D1 and T1 are ours. 'quantity' uses ngspice's vector names.

f3a-1M-trap.note: 1M is 1 milliohm, so almost all of the 6 V appears across R2: 6 * 1e6 / (1e6 + 1e-3) = 5.999999994 V

f4-tf-output-impedance.note: R3 carries no current, so v(a) = v(n1) = 24 * 3/9 = 8 V; output impedance = R3 + R1||R2 = 2 + 2 = 4 ohms; input impedance = R1 + R2 = 9 ohms

f5-thevenin-cccs.note: 1 A test current into a; F1 pushes 2 x 1 A into n1, so 3 A flow down R1: v(n1) = 12 V, v(x) = 12 + 2 = 14 V, v(a) = v(x) because Vx is 0 V. Thevenin resistance 14 V / 1 A = 14 ohms

d1-dc-divider-sweep.note: v(out) = V1 * 2k / (1k + 2k) at each of the 13 sweep points

t1-tran-rc-charge.note: tau = 1k * 1u = 1 ms; v(out) close to 5 * (1 - exp(-t / 1 ms)); at t = 5 ms about 4.966 V
